L&T ELARA CELESTIA –APARTMENTS IN HEBBAL, BANGALORE

L&T Elara Celestia is an newly launched apartment community property developed by L&T Realty, located in Hebbal, North Bangalore. The project is spread across 10 acres of prime real estate, adjacent to Phoenix Mall of Asia and the existing Raintree Boulevard project. The development offers spacious 3 & 4 BHK apartments of sizes ranging 1400 sq.ft to 3100 Sq.ft. Pay 10% Down Payment Booking amount and buy a unit in Elara Celestia by L&T Realty Bengaluru. LnT offers attractive pricing with 3 Bedroom price starting 2.7 Cr with flexible instalment Payment Plans, this project is designed to provide a perfect blend of modern living, superior connectivity, and green surroundings.

What is the total land area of L&T Elara Celestia?

The project spans across 10 acres of prime real estate in North Bangalore.
